question: How many integer solutions of the inequality \(x^2-4>0\) have an absolute value less than 4?
solution: \(x^2>4\) gives \(x<-2\) or \(x>2\). With the additional restriction \(-4<x<4\), the only integer solutions are \(-3\) and 3, giving 2 in total.
